name: Star-Cube
description: Fun and beautiful platform game made entirely with vanilla.s vector art creating shots with plot twists and unexpected surprises

paragraphs: Un juego de plataformas y disparos 2D desarrollado completamente desde cero usando Vanilla JavaScript y HTML5 Canvas. Todo el juego está diseñado al 100% con puro arte vectorial procedural nativo del navegador, ¡sin utilizar ningún sprite ni motores externos!

Star Cube is an agile 2D platformer focused on swift movement: precise aerial control, omnidirectional dashing, and gradual charge shooting. It was engineered for ultra-low overhead to run smoothly on any modern desktop and mobile web browser.
You play as Peggy, an acrobatic cube. Your mission is to rescue your imprisoned friends across six distinct zones and defeat the bosses who command each world.
features: World 1: Explore the scenic Dawn Meadow and stunning Glacial Caverns. Face the icy specter (Ice Cube) who cursed the meadow, freezing it into an icy domain.
World 2: Venture into a digitized grid. Battle electric foes and the rogue MawlerKnight, who hacks the system to disrupt your controls.
World 3: Traverse molten lava rivers in the fiery volcano and defeat the Valkyrie Sentinel before you get incinerated.
World 4: Sail your boat against rough oceanic waves and descend into abyssal depths to battle the Krakatoa Kraken.
